Pra-Loup's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-organised childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. With a summit at 2,600 m and a village at 1,500 m, Pra-Loup's snow reliability is generally good from January to the end of March.
